function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The severe imbalance in baseline severity between sexes in the treatment arm (females: 61% mild/moderate; males: 78% severe) confirms that sex and severity are confounded. Since the trial was not randomised, this imbalance means that any raw comparison between sexes would be biased. Therefore, we adjusted for severity using weighted averaging based on the overall severity distribution. This provides a fairer comparison of response rates between sexes, holding severity distribution constant. The adjusted difference is the appropriate estimate for the question."}
